name: search_exact
description: Find literal substrings in live page bodies and compiled truth, without ranking or embeddings. Returns slug, title, source_id and one snippet per matching page. complete:true means every match was returned; false means limit or a 2-second timeout. scanned counts eligible pages examined (null on timeout). Scoped to your sources; excludes hidden pages. Internal-only.

phrase.description: Literal phrase, 1 to 500 characters. %, _ and backslash have no special meaning.

name: search
description: Ranked vector+keyword chunks, paths and titles. Language/symbol/date/type/slug-prefix filters precede limits and bypass cache. Broad concept/set questions can use query expand:true (paid, default-off); search has no expand. Hits are not exhaustive. meta exposes vectorEnabled/degraded; intent/mode/cache/counts are operator-only. Empty results include a recovery hint.

source_ids.description: Narrow to ≤100 exact source IDs in your grant. Omitted uses grant; [] reads nothing; any forbidden ID refuses the call.

types.description: Up to 20 lower-case page type names. Matches canonical live pages and their indexed mirrors/file twins; non-page documents are excluded. Empty means no type filter.

slug_prefix.description: Literal canonical page slug prefix, e.g. projects/x/. No wildcards. Applied before retrieval limits.

k.description: Number of hits to return. Default 20.

token_budget.description: Cap returned title + content (~chars/4 tokens), including trust frames. Keep whole hits in rank order; stop before the first that overflows. Omitted: mode default.

lang.description: Filter to chunks of a source language (chunks.language, e.g. 'typescript', 'python'). Code chunks only.

symbol_kind.description: Filter to chunks of a symbol kind (chunks.symbol_type, e.g. 'function', 'class', 'method').

since.description: Keep only hits whose content date COALESCE(effective_date, updated_at) is >= this bound: an ISO-8601 date/datetime, or a relative duration like '7d' / '2w' / '6m' / '1y' (back from now).

until.description: Upper bound on COALESCE(effective_date,updated_at): ISO date/time (YYYY-MM-DD includes the whole day), or duration back from now: 7d/2w/6m/1y.

near_symbol.description: Anchor retrieval at this qualified symbol name (e.g. 'BrainEngine::searchKeyword'). Its chunk(s) join the candidate set and seed a structural walk of the code call graph. Code corpora only.

walk_depth.description: Structural walk depth 0-2 (default 0 = off). Expands the anchors through code_edges_symbol with 1/(1+hop) score decay. Code corpora only; bypasses the query cache.

explain.description: Stamp each hit with a per-signal ranking attribution (`explain`: base score + the factor every boost stage contributed + reranker delta). Bypasses the query cache.

offset.description: Skip the first N ranked hits (pagination). Applied after ranking; the widened fetch bypasses nothing else.

mode.description: Per-call search mode bundle. Honored ONLY for the operator (local/static-bearer) caller; a tenant token's mode is silently ignored (it cannot escalate to the paid tokenmax bundle).

name: index
description: Index a markdown document. Either pass `path` (an absolute path the daemon can read) or `sourcePath` + `text` (in-memory).

name: backlinks
description: Find what links to a target. Default type `wikilink`: `name` (a page name or slug, any script) is resolved to its canonical page slug, redirects and declared aliases included, and the pages linking to it are returned (`sourcePath` is the page's `page://` path, `surfaceForm` the target slug). Type `tag` / `date`: documents whose chunks mention that tag or date.

name: stats
description: Counts of indexed documents / chunks / embeddings. Cheap; no Bedrock calls.

name: source_health
description: Source-scoped document/chunk counts, embeddable coverage (excluding code), and staleness lag. Only local/unscoped callers see the NULL-source (unclassified) bucket and whole-brain health roll-up. Read-only, cheap, no Bedrock.

name: log_friction
description: Record a friction event — used by the agent to flag when retrieval missed, an answer felt wrong, a tool errored out, OR when a recall produced an unexpectedly good hit (`delight`). When invoked from a skill, include extra.skill = '<skill-slug>' so `memrain friction propose-fix` can group the event with the skill that fired it. Set `severity` to confused/error/blocker/nit on negative kinds for triage.

name: page_put
description: Create/replace a DB-canonical page; identical content is a no-op, changes append history. Prefer page_edit for partial changes. Mirrors normally return search_indexed; queued ones return search_pending + search_job_id; wait_for_index waits. MEMRAIN_REQUIRE_WRITE_PRECONDITION makes missing expected_version/force warn or refuse with precondition_required + current_version. Public writes need MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

reason.description: Optional trimmed one-line reason, ≤500 Unicode code points; secret-scanned, stored only with a new version.

slug.description: kebab-case identifier with optional `/` namespaces (e.g. people/alice, journal/2026/05/2026-05-18). New slugs cannot have repeated or trailing hyphens in any segment; existing slugs remain writable.

type.description: Optional: concept/person/company/meeting/idea/journal/note/email/event/decision/task/source. Inferred from slug prefix (people/→person), else note. Other types require allowAdHocType:true.

compiled_truth.description: Editable jsonb header (tags, related slugs, tier, enriched_at, …).

written_by.description: Optional caller identifier for the audit trail (skill slug, recipe name, …).

allow_empty_body.description: Clear the page's body on purpose. Without it an empty markdown_body over a page that has one is refused; an OMITTED markdown_body keeps the current body.

allow_shrink.description: Allow an intentional replacement smaller than half of a body over 32 KiB when the write-precondition policy is enabled. Prefer page_edit for partial changes.

wait_for_index.description: Write the search mirror before returning even when mirrors are queued, so the page is searchable the moment this call returns. Slower.

expected_version.description: Require this page_get version/page_versions version_n; 0 requires absence. Deleted pages retain versions: use current_version from a failed 0 attempt. Mismatch writes nothing and returns current_version. Omit for an unconditional write, subject to precondition policy.

force.description: Overwrite unconditionally, on purpose. Cannot be combined with expected_version.

request_id.description: Optional retry id (1-128 chars), retained 7 days. Same id+arguments replays the first result (replayed:true), without writing; changed arguments are refused.

name: page_append
description: Append to an existing page body and add a version; use page_put to create. Search readiness returns search_indexed, or search_pending + search_job_id for queued mirrors (normally seconds). wait_for_index:true waits for search readiness. Public writes require MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

wait_for_index.description: Write the search mirror before returning even when mirrors are queued, so the page is searchable the moment this call returns. Slower.

request_id.description: Optional retry id (1-128 chars), retained 7 days. Same id+arguments replays the first result (replayed:true), without writing; changed arguments are refused.

name: page_edit
description: Atomically apply 1..50 ordered exact-text body replacements, preserving title/frontmatter. Copy unique old_text from page_get; misses/duplicates give edit_no_match/edit_ambiguous_match. Facts/takes fences and markers are protected (edit_protected_span); use their writers. Requires expected_version; conflict returns current_version. Returns version and diff capped at 8 KB (diff_truncated). Indexing follows page_put; wait_for_index waits. Public writes need MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

reason.description: Optional trimmed one-line reason, ≤500 Unicode code points; secret-scanned, stored only with a new version.

slug.description: The page to edit; it must exist.

expected_version.description: The page's current version (`version` from page_get). On a mismatch nothing is written and the error names the current version.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace; must occur exactly once.

edits.description: 1 to 50 replacements, applied in order, all or nothing.

written_by.description: Optional caller identifier for the audit trail (skill slug, recipe name, …).

wait_for_index.description: Write the search mirror before returning even when mirrors are queued, so the change is searchable the moment this call returns. Slower.

request_id.description: Optional retry id (1-128 chars), retained 7 days. Same id+arguments replays the first result (replayed:true), without writing; changed arguments are refused.

name: page_rename
description: Rename a page, carrying its history, facts, links and timeline and redirecting the old slug. Requires expected_version from page_get. Refuses imported pages; rename them upstream. Old search mirrors are removed immediately; the next cycle indexes the new slug. Both slugs must be within your write grant. Static public bearer: forbidden.

name: page_delete
description: Idempotent soft-delete: sets deleted_at, retains page and version history. Requires source-scoped write or internal token; static public bearer forbidden.

reason.description: Optional trimmed one-line reason, ≤500 Unicode code points; secret-scanned, stored only with a new version.

expected_version.description: Require this page_get version/page_versions version_n; 0 requires absence. Deleted pages retain versions: use current_version from a failed 0 attempt. Mismatch writes nothing and returns current_version. Omit for an unconditional write, subject to precondition policy.

force.description: Overwrite unconditionally, on purpose. Cannot be combined with expected_version.

name: page_restore
description: Undelete a soft-deleted page (clears deleted_at). The inverse of page_delete; no-op if the page is missing or already live. WRITE — static public bearer: forbidden; authenticated token: requires the `write` scope (source-scoped); internal token: allowed.

name: page_revert
description: Restore a prior body snapshot as a NEW version, retaining history. version names the target version_n from page_versions. Requires source-scoped write or internal token; static public bearer forbidden.

reason.description: Optional trimmed one-line reason, ≤500 Unicode code points; secret-scanned, stored only with a new version.

expected_version.description: Require this page_get version/page_versions version_n; 0 requires absence. Deleted pages retain versions: use current_version from a failed 0 attempt. Mismatch writes nothing and returns current_version. Omit for an unconditional write, subject to precondition policy.

force.description: Overwrite unconditionally, on purpose. Cannot be combined with expected_version.

name: page_get
description: Read a page or error on absence. fuzzy:true resolves a unique fuzzy miss; multiple candidates return ambiguous_slug + candidates. include_deleted:true exposes soft-deleted pages with deleted_at for restoration. Pass returned version as expected_version on later writes to guard races.

source_id.description: Owning source from a search result; narrows the caller's read grant, never expands it.

version.description: Read stored body/truth/hash plus written_at; version differs from current_version. Identity/title stay current. Missing snapshot: version_not_found.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset for a body window; use the returned next_offset to continue.

max_bytes.description: Body window size in UTF-8 bytes (default 256 KiB). Windows return body_window instead of markdown_body; use page_edit or page_append to change a page.

fuzzy.description: Fuzzy slug resolution on a miss (default false).

include_quarantined.description: Admin-only quarantined body access. Others receive metadata, quarantined and notice:page_quarantined, without body.

name: page_list
description: List pages, newest-first by default. Optional filters: `type`, `tag` (normalized), `since` (ISO timestamp), `limit` (1..100, default 50). `sort` picks the order (updated_desc default | updated_asc | created_desc | slug); `include_deleted:true` adds soft-deleted pages with deleted_at populated.

source_ids.description: Narrow to ≤100 exact source IDs in your grant. Omitted uses grant; [] reads nothing; any forbidden ID refuses the call.

tag.description: Filter to pages carrying this tag.

include_body.description: Include markdown_body and compiled_truth (default true). Set false for metadata-only listing.

slug_prefix.description: Literal slug prefix, e.g. projects/x/ for a subtree. No wildcards or relative paths.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous page with the same filters, sort and source access. Limit and include_body may change. complete:true means no more rows at read time.

name: page_versions
description: Version history, newest first. Metadata by default; include_body:true adds authorized body/truth snapshots. Operator/admin callers also receive written_by_principal (null for legacy/internal versions).

include_body.description: Include body_snapshot and compiled_truth_snapshot (default false). Quarantine and public redaction still apply.

name: link
description: Assert a typed source→target link; repeating (source,target,type) updates confidence/chunk_id. Confidence defaults 1. works_at/located_at hold one value at a time: a new dated value closes the open one; an overlap, or no valid_from once dated, is refused (link_interval_conflict). Public writes require MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

valid_from.description: Optional inclusive start YYYY-MM-DD. Omission preserves the stored bound; an existing bound cannot change.

valid_until.description: Optional exclusive end YYYY-MM-DD. Must follow valid_from; an existing bound cannot change.

source_slug.description: The source page slug. Must reference an existing page (FK constraint).

target_slug.description: The target slug (soft reference; the page may or may not yet exist). Loose names like `Alice Smith` are normalised to `alice-smith`.

type.description: One of: wikilink, mentions, works_at, attended, founded, advises, invested_in, knows, met, located_at, related_to, supersedes, contradicts. Pass allowAdHocType=true to accept other types.

confidence.description: 0..1, default 1.0 for agent-asserted edges. Use <1.0 only for deterministic-extractor outputs whose surface form was ambiguous.

name: unlink
description: Remove a manually created typed link. Returns removed and derived_from_text for edges still supplied by markdown/frontmatter/mentions; edit the source page with page_edit to remove those. Idempotent. WRITE — static public bearer: forbidden; authenticated token: requires write scope in its source; internal token: allowed.

name: graph_neighbors
description: Links touching slug, newest first, with direction per row. Select outbound, inbound or both and optional type.

status.description: Filter manual link validity; default all. Half-open end date.

as_of.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD for an explicit status other than all; defaults to today UTC.

type.description: Filter to a single link type.

name: graph_query
description: Typed links matching type and at least one of source_slug/target_slug; e.g. works_at + a person source finds their companies, or a company target finds its people.

status.description: Filter manual link validity; default all. Half-open end date.

as_of.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD for an explicit status other than all; defaults to today UTC.

name: traverse_graph
description: Breadth-first graph walk; each node appears once at shortest depth. truncated means eligible nodes within max_depth exceeded limit: narrow type/depth. Direction defaults outbound (also inbound/both); depth default 3, range 1..10; limit default 100, range 1..1000.

status.description: Filter manual link validity; default all. Half-open end date.

as_of.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD for an explicit status other than all; defaults to today UTC.

name: add_fact
description: Record an entity claim; corrections create new facts. Identical entity/source/writer claims refresh (inserted:false). Withdrawn entity/source/visibility claims stay withdrawn across case/whitespace changes (withdrawn:true,id:null). Default private is operator-only; tenants use world to recall writes. Provenance: source_slug/source_chunk_id/written_by, else caller; public cannot set written_by. replaces supersedes a live fact, returning replaced. Batch ≤20 items inherits top-level defaults; all validate before writing. Results include saved/failed/partial and outcomes; all-failed is a tool error, mixed status:partial. Public forbids items/replaces; writes need MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

valid_from.description: Date the claim became true (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp, stored as its UTC date).

claim_metric.description: Metric name; normalized to lower-case snake_case.

claim_value.description: Finite numeric value; put the unit in claim_unit.

entity_slug.description: Entity (e.g. people/alice); required unless every batch item names one. A bare name resolves uniquely within your write source (entity_resolved_from), else stays unchanged with entity_unresolved and ≤5 candidates. Qualified slugs need not exist.

fact.description: Short claim, one sentence. Required unless `items` is given.

source_slug.description: Page the fact was extracted from.

visibility.description: Who may read the fact back. `private` (the default) is operator-only; `world` is also readable by tenant-scoped and public callers. Ignored on public ingress, which always writes `private`.

request_id.description: Optional retry id (1-128 chars), retained 7 days. Same id+arguments replays the first result (replayed:true), without writing; changed arguments are refused.

replaces.description: Id of a live fact in your own source that this fact replaces. Not combinable with `items` (put it on the item instead).

items.description: Batch 1..20 {fact,entity_slug?,confidence?,visibility?,replaces?}, instead of fact. Items override top-level valid_from/kind/notability/claim_metric/value/unit/period defaults.

name: add_timeline_event
description: Append a timeline event to an existing page. Returns the stored row, including the original on a duplicate, subject to read redaction. Correct a mistake by appending a new event describing the correction; the original remains. Idempotent on (slug, occurred_at, source_chunk_id) when source_chunk_id is provided. WRITE — refused on public ingress unless the operator sets MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

slug.description: The page the event is attached to. Must reference an existing page (FK CASCADE).

occurred_at.description: When the event happened (ISO-8601). Not when it was recorded.

request_id.description: Optional retry id (1-128 chars), retained 7 days. Same id+arguments replays the first result (replayed:true), without writing; changed arguments are refused.

name: entity_facts
description: Entity facts ordered by confidence (default) or recency; omit entity_slug for cross-entity recall. Filter by written_at since, originating source_slug, capture session, case-insensitive grep or private/world visibility. include_forgotten adds audit tombstones for internal callers; public forces it off.

entity_slug.description: Entity to scope to. Omit for a cross-entity recall.

query.description: Semantic focus: one Titan embedding of first 512 characters, cosine ≥0.35; also facts_groups without entity_slug. Public ignores it; unavailable embedding returns normal order + hint.

session.description: Filter to facts captured under this session id.

grep.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the fact text.

include_forgotten.description: Include tombstoned (forgotten) rows. Internal-only; default false.

name: fact_supersessions
description: Supersession audit log: facts retired WITH a replacement pointer (forgotten_at + superseded_by both set), newest retirement first. Each row is the RETIRED fact; superseded_by points at its replacement. Optional `entity_slug` / `since` (ISO, on the retirement time) / `limit` (1..1000, default 50). Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

name: entity_timeline
description: Chronological event log for a page. Newest-first. Optional `since` / `until` date bounds.

name: entity_recall
description: One-shot 'what do I know about X?' aggregator. Returns the entity's page (compiled_truth + body) plus top-confidence facts plus most-recent timeline events in a single call. The page may be null when the entity exists only as a soft-stub (facts + timeline allowed, page not yet promoted). A fact that conflicts with another visible typed claim lists the peer ids in contested_with.

query.description: Optional semantic fact focus (e.g. funding history), replacing confidence order; falls back to confidence when embedding is unavailable.

redact_body.description: When true, strips markdown_body from the page row. The HTTP public-bearer path forces this on by default; internal MCP callers default false.

token_budget.description: Approximate whole-response token cap, measured on serialized visible rows after redaction. Server reallocates unused page/facts/timeline shares and truncates the body. budget reports facts_dropped, timeline_dropped, page_truncated and page_dropped; page:null with page_dropped means it did not fit, not that it is absent.

include_pending.description: Piggy-back `pending_consolidation_count` (live facts not yet folded into a consolidated take) on the response. One round trip; field omitted when false.

name: jobs_submit
description: Submit a durable job; `kind` must be a registered handler kind. Idempotent when `idempotency_key` is provided (re-submit returns the existing row). Optional `parent_job_id` records a fan-out edge so the parent can detect fan-in via the child-done inbox. WRITE — refused on public ingress.

name: jobs_cancel
description: Cancel a pending job. By default cascades to all pending descendants. WRITE — refused on public ingress.

name: jobs_list
description: List jobs newest-first. Optional filters: status, kind, parent_job_id, since (ISO timestamp), limit (1..1000, default 100).

name: jobs_get
description: Get the full detail of a job including payload, result, children, and unread child-done inbox count.

name: jobs_logs
description: Compact log view of a job: status, retries, last_error, children count + status breakdown, unread inbox count. Designed to fit in a single chat reply.

name: submit_agent
description: Queue a read-only research agent that runs under your own grant: it reads only your sources, uses only the read tools your client is bound to, spends against your daily budget, and stops if your grant is revoked or changed. Returns a job_id; poll get_agent_job. Needs the 'agent' scope, a daily budget on your client, and a free slot under your client's concurrency limit. Writes nothing.

task.description: What the agent should find out, in plain language (at most 8 KB).

max_usd.description: Spend ceiling for this job in USD; clamped to the brain's per-job ceiling.

name: get_agent_job
description: Status and answer of an agent job you submitted with submit_agent: status, stop_reason, final_text, cost_usd, turns and an error when it failed. A job that is not yours reads as not found.

name: get_chunks
description: Return a page's (or document's) content chunks in order. Pass `slug` (resolved through the page's page://<slug> search mirror) or `source_path` (a raw document). At least one is required. Returns at most limit chunks (default 200), ordered by chunk_index with an id tie-break; truncated:true means more remain. Continue with from_index increased by the number returned.

from_index.description: Zero-based position in the ordered, source-filtered result (default 0).

name: resolve_slugs
description: Resolve names to live slugs: exact slug, then fuzzy title/slug. exact:true matches only slug/title/basename/declared alias/email (compiled_truth.email or identity.email; email needs body access). Reports ambiguity even at limit:1. Hits: slug,title,score,referenced_by_count (distinct visible referring pages in scope).

name: add_tag
description: Add a tag to a page (normalized: trim + lowercase). Idempotent. The page must exist. WRITE — refused on public ingress unless the operator sets MEMRAIN_PUBLIC_WRITE=1.

name: remove_tag
description: Remove a tag from a page. Idempotent (removing an absent tag is a no-op). WRITE — static public bearer: forbidden; authenticated token: requires the `write` scope (source-scoped); internal token: allowed.

name: get_tags
description: List a page's tags in lexical order. Empty list for an unknown or untagged page.

name: relational_recall
description: Deterministic relational query — resolves a seed entity from a natural-language relationship question ('who does alice report to?', 'who works at acme', 'how is alice connected to bob') and fans out typed edges. Returns [{slug, relation, depth}]. No LLM.

name: get_links
description: Edges touching slug, grouped by type and outbound/inbound direction (source/target respectively). Groups sort by type, outbound first; edges newest first. limit caps each direction: default/max 1000, minimum 1.

status.description: Filter manual link validity; default all. Half-open end date.

as_of.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD for an explicit status other than all; defaults to today UTC.

name: list_link_sources
description: The link-type catalogue with live per-type edge counts. Every KNOWN_LINK_TYPES entry is returned (count 0 when unused), plus any ad-hoc type present in the graph (known:false). Ordered by count DESC then type ASC, so the most-used relationship types surface first while the full vocabulary stays discoverable. Returns [{type, count, known}].

name: find_orphans
description: Pages with zero inbound links — nothing in the graph references them. The natural enrichment targets (a page nobody links to is new or forgotten). Newest-first. Optional `type` page-type filter; `limit` (1..1000, default 50). Deterministic, no LLM.

type.description: Restrict to a single page type (e.g. person).

name: wanted_pages
description: Unresolved targets linked by live visible pages in your sources, most-referenced first. Returns target_slug,referenced_by,sample_from (≤3 slugs),surface,first_seen. Hidden pages never count. Limit default 50, range 1..200. Deterministic, no LLM.

name: find_experts
description: With topic: person/company expertise from hybrid search × relationship recency (6-month half-life) × salience. Without topic: graph hubs by distinct live in/out neighbours, excluding unresolved stubs. type overrides topic candidates or filters hubs. Limit default 5, range 1..200; deterministic, no LLM.

topic.description: Optional topic query. When set, ranks person/company pages by expertise + recency + salience. When omitted, returns graph link-degree hubs.

type.description: Restrict to a single page type (overrides the person/company default in topic mode).

explain.description: Topic mode only: include the per-result factor breakdown (expertise, recency, salience) behind `score`.

name: find_contradictions
description: Read conflicts without an LLM call. Default returns explicit contradicts page edges and cached opt-in probe findings (severity/axis/confidence/resolution_command; empty before probing). slug filters either edge endpoint; limit default 20, max 200. mode:typed finds overlapping numeric disagreements; use entity_slug, not slug/severity.

mode.description: typed: deterministic overlapping numeric conflicts in the same unit/period/month/source. Omit for asserted/probed findings.

entity_slug.description: Exact entity filter for typed mode only.

slug.description: Substring filter; matches either side of the pair (case-insensitive).

severity.description: Filter the probed findings by severity (edges have no severity axis).

name: find_trajectory
description: Chronological 'how did this entity change?' log for one slug — the merged, oldest-first view of its entity_facts ledger and its timeline_events. Each fact anchors at its valid_from (else written_at); each event at occurred_at. Optional `since`/`until` ISO bounds on that anchor; `limit` (1..500, default 100). Deterministic, no LLM.

entity_slug.description: The entity to chart (e.g. companies/acme, people/alice).

metric.description: Filter to a single canonical metric label (mig070 claim_metric, e.g. 'mrr'); timeline events are excluded for a metric query.

kind.description: Row-shape filter (mig070): 'metric' = typed-claim fact rows only, 'event' = event-shaped rows (event_type facts + timeline events), 'all' (default) = merged chronology.

since.description: Lower bound (ISO timestamp) on the point's anchor date.

name: get_recent_salience
description: Live pages ranked by the deterministic `salience` score (migration 036: high-emotion tags + graph link-degree, recomputed by the recompute-salience cycle phase) — the 'what matters' read. Optional `type` filter and `days` recency window. No LLM, no Bedrock. Surfaces page slugs/titles — hidden from public ingress.

type.description: Filter to a single page type (exact match), e.g. person.

days.description: Only pages updated within the last N days. Omit for all-time.

recency_bias.description: 'flat' (default) = pure salience order (historical behavior). 'on' = rank by salience x 1/(1+days_old) — 'what's been salient lately'.

name: find_anomalies
description: Live-graph outliers: degree_outlier (degree ≥ mean + sigma·stddev) and stale_salient (high salience, updated_at older than staleDays). Uses structural signals, not retrieval/access counters. No LLM; public forbidden (page slugs/titles).

sigma.description: Std-devs above the mean degree to flag a hub (default 2).

staleDays.description: Days an updated_at must lag to count a salient page stale (default 90).

salienceFloor.description: Salience floor for the stale_salient class (default 0.5).

name: recall
description: Read ONE known numeric fact id: claim, confidence, source and metadata. Unknown/forgotten ids error. For discovery use entity_facts (entity facts), entity_recall (entity context) or search (corpus); this is neither search nor listing.

name: forget_fact
description: Durably withdraw by id within entity/source/visibility, retiring identical live copies (withdrawn_duplicates). Re-add/extraction/import cannot revive it; no undo, audit retained. Repeats no-op; unknown id gives found:false. Stores optional reason. Returns ≤5 similar_active ids/scores for distinct rewordings: confirm separately. Requires owning-source write; static public forbidden.

reason.description: Optional audit note stored on the forgotten row.

name: get_brain_identity
description: Brain identity + counters for a thin-client banner. Returns the running version, the storage engine kind, and corpus counts (documents / chunks / embeddings / pages / sources) plus the brain's earliest created_at. Counts only — no slugs, titles, or bodies. Cheap; no Bedrock.

name: whoami
description: Show the calling identity and grant: client_id, scopes, write_source, read_sources, is_public, operator, bound_slug_prefixes, takes_holders, budget_usd_per_day, spent_today_usd, spend_id and callable_tools. Unscoped read_sources is null; absent grant fields are null. callable_tools matches tools/list. Reveals only the caller's auth context, no corpus or Bedrock call.

name: purge_deleted_pages
description: HARD-delete soft-deleted pages older than older_than_hours (default 720 = 30 days; document cycle TTL stays 72). Cascades page versions, aliases and links; also deletes raw_data, tags and redirects to purged slugs, with per-table counts. Returns reaped slugs, count and ttl_hours. Admin scope in the owning source or internal token required; static public bearer forbidden. page_delete needs write scope; purge needs admin.

older_than_hours.description: Age cutoff in hours. Pages soft-deleted longer ago than this are reaped. Default 720 (30 days).

slugs.description: Only these slugs, and only those soft-deleted past the cutoff. Omit to reap every expired page.

dry_run.description: Reap nothing; return `planned` (the slugs a real run would reap now) and its `plan_hash`.

expected_plan_hash.description: The `plan_hash` of an earlier dry run. The purge is refused unless the plan still hashes the same, so exactly the reviewed pages go.

name: query
description: Hybrid retrieval with detail, salience/recency, date/code filters, offset and adaptive_return. expand is paid (mode default); mode overrides are operator-only. refine+weights uses deterministic two-query RRF. Otherwise returns search meta; counts are operator-only. token_budget without k considers 100 hits; explicit k wins. Adds ≤3 lexical ledger facts within budget, respecting source/visibility/diary fences; chunk filters affect hits. Empty results include a recovery hint.

source_ids.description: Narrow to ≤100 exact source IDs in your grant. Omitted uses grant; [] reads nothing; any forbidden ID refuses the call.

types.description: Up to 20 lower-case page type names. Matches canonical live pages and their indexed mirrors/file twins; non-page documents are excluded. Empty means no type filter.

slug_prefix.description: Literal canonical page slug prefix, e.g. projects/x/. No wildcards. Applied before retrieval limits.

k.description: Number of hits to return. Default 20; without refine, token_budget and no k uses up to 100 candidates.

offset.description: Skip the first N ranked hits (pagination).

expand.description: Force LLM query expansion on/off for this call (paid Haiku). Omit = mode-bundle default (OFF in conservative/balanced).

detail.description: Result detail: low = compiled-truth-grade brevity (1 chunk per page), medium (default) = per-page dedup, high = all chunks + temporal source-boost bypass.

mode.description: Search mode bundle for this call. Operator-only; a tenant token's mode is silently ignored.

salience.description: Mattering bias (pages.salience: emotional weight + link degree + takes). Omit = auto-detect from the query phrasing.

recency.description: Recency boost (per-prefix hyperbolic freshness lift). 'strong' for 'today / right now'. Omit = auto-detect.

since.description: Keep only hits whose content date is >= this ISO-8601 date.

until.description: Keep only hits whose content date is <= this ISO-8601 date.

lang.description: Filter to chunks of a source language (code corpora).

symbol_kind.description: Filter to chunks of a symbol kind (code corpora).

near_symbol.description: Anchor retrieval at this qualified symbol name (code corpora).

token_budget.description: Cap total returned content size (~chars/4 tokens).

adaptive_return.description: Return a TIGHT intent-sized result set instead of the full top-K (never empty when there are matches; first page only).

explain.description: Stamp per-hit ranking attribution. Bypasses the query cache.

refine.description: LEGACY refinement: second term for the deterministic weighted-RRF blend. When set, only k/weights apply.

primary_weight.description: RRF weight for the primary query (refine mode). Default 1.

refine_weight.description: RRF weight for the refine term (refine mode). Default 1.

name: code_callers
description: Call sites for symbol name (surface,chunk,path), with language/kind/line bounds and authorized opening snippets. Empty reads carry scoped readiness {state,code_documents,symbols}: not_built/indexing/no_symbols/ready; only ready proves absence. Limit default 200, range 1..1000; optional lang. Deterministic, no LLM.

name.description: Bare symbol name to find callers of (e.g. `hybridSearch`).

lang.description: Only mentions from chunks of this source language (e.g. `typescript`, `python`, `go`).

name: code_callees
description: Callees of target path:line (innermost definition) or symbol; qualified names restrict sites. resolved_symbol is definition or null. Returns language/kind/line bounds and authorized opening snippets. Empty reads carry scoped readiness; only ready proves absence. Limit default 200/max 1000; optional lang. Deterministic, no LLM.

target.description: `<path>:<line>` of a symbol body (e.g. `src/x.ts:42`), or a symbol name, bare or qualified (e.g. `save` or `Repo::save`).

lang.description: Only mentions from chunks of this source language (e.g. `typescript`, `python`, `go`).

name: code_def
description: Find code-def mentions for symbol name across indexed code: surface form, chunk, source path, language, kind, line bounds and an authorized opening snippet. Empty reads carry scoped readiness: not_built, indexing, no_symbols or ready. Only ready proves absence. Deterministic, no LLM; limit defaults 200 (max 1000), optional lang.

name.description: Bare symbol name to locate definitions of (e.g. `hybridSearch`, `Storage`).

lang.description: Only mentions from chunks of this source language (e.g. `typescript`, `python`, `go`).

name: code_refs
description: Non-call code-ref mentions for symbol name (imports/type uses/other references); complements code_callers. Includes language/kind/line bounds and authorized opening snippets. Empty reads carry scoped readiness {state,code_documents,symbols}: not_built/indexing/no_symbols/ready; only ready proves absence. Limit default 200, range 1..1000; optional lang. Deterministic, no LLM.

name.description: Bare symbol name to find references to (e.g. `hybridSearch`).

lang.description: Only mentions from chunks of this source language (e.g. `typescript`, `python`, `go`).

name: code_blast
description: Transitive callers by BFS depth for change-impact checks. depth default 5/max 8; max_nodes default 200. Returns result (ok/not_found/ambiguous), depth_groups, cycles_detected, truncation and optional candidates/did_you_mean. Nodes: symbol,chunk_id,def_chunk_id,resolved (definition-backed vs by-name). Empty reads carry scoped readiness; only ready proves absence. No LLM.

symbol.description: Bare or qualified symbol name (e.g. `performSync` or `Foo::performSync`).

exact.description: Skip bare-name disambiguation; treat `symbol` as an exact qualified name.

lang.description: Walk only chunks of this source language. Omitted: the start symbol's language when all its definitions share one.

name: code_flow
description: Transitive callees by BFS depth; code_blast envelope plus terminal_nodes [{symbol,sink_kind:db_call/http_call/file_io/process_exec}]. depth default 8/max 12; max_nodes default 200. Language-specific names detect sinks; generic get/put/read/write do not. Empty reads carry readiness; only ready proves absence. No LLM.

exact.description: Skip bare-name disambiguation; treat `symbol` as an exact qualified name.

lang.description: Walk only chunks of this source language. Omitted: the start symbol's language when all its definitions share one.

name: volunteer_context
description: Resolve rolling-window entity mentions to page pointers: alias .9/title .8/slug-suffix .6, +.05 for newest-turn or ≥2-turn mentions; confidence gate and cap N. Returns [{slug,title,display,confidence,arm,rationale,synopsis}]. Deterministic, no Bedrock. Public forbidden (slugs/titles/synopses). stats:true gives approximate per-arm used/volunteered precision from last_retrieved_at.

window.description: Conversation window text. 'user:'/'assistant:' line prefixes set the role; unprefixed input is one user turn. Required unless stats:true.

prior_context.description: Already-surfaced context (pointer blocks / opened page bodies). Pages whose slug appears here are not re-volunteered.

min_confidence.description: Confidence gate 0..1 (default 0.7). At the default, slug-suffix matches never volunteer.

session_id.description: Opaque session id stamped on each logged volunteer event.

turn.description: Turn number stamped on each logged volunteer event.

stats.description: Return per-arm used/volunteered precision stats instead of volunteering.

days.description: Stats window in days (default 30; stats mode only).

name: context_delta
description: Bounded recent pages (metadata), facts and events since a date/UTC timestamp; each section has truncated and time_basis. Not a complete change log/snapshot. Read-only, no retrieval touch/inference; internal-only.

source_ids.description: Narrow within your source grant; [] reads nothing.

name: quarantine_list
description: Operator-only, read-only quarantined IDs/sources/paths/fixed reason codes. No titles, bodies or free-form details. Default 20, max 100.

source_ids.description: Narrow to exact sources; [] reads nothing.

name: extraction_review
description: Operator-only metadata candidates: missing same-source entity pages and similar facts from at most 200 recent eligible rows; scanned/scan_truncated report bounds. No queues, merges, deletes or models.

source_ids.description: Narrow to exact sources; [] reads nothing.

name: context_pack
description: Budgeted entity cards (title,type,facts,events; no body), up to 8: explicit slugs first, then window entities at the volunteer default gate. Adds top decayed facts across the grant, excluding card duplicates. token_budget prioritizes cards; budget reports drops. Hidden/missing slugs both yield no card. Conflicting facts carry contested_with. Operator-pinned pages (MEMRAIN_CONTEXT_CORE_SLUGS) come first as core, charged before cards. Stateless read, no LLM; internal-only.

slugs.description: Entity page slugs to build cards for, in priority order (array of strings).

window.description: Conversation window text; entities it names fill the card slots left after `slugs`. 'user:'/'assistant:' line prefixes set the role.

facts_limit.description: Max brain facts after the cards (default 10, cap 25).

token_budget.description: Token budget for cards + facts (default 1500, clamped 200..8000).

name: advisor
description: Ranked, read-only "what to do next" for this brain: pending migrations, version drift, stalled/failed jobs, low embedding coverage, and setup smells. Each finding has a severity (high/medium/low/info), a why-it-matters, and the exact fix command. Never mutates, never calls an LLM. Tell the user; ask before running any fix. Internal-only.

name: list_brain_skillpack
description: Read the served deploy/skills catalog (also list_skills): slug, description, triggers, mutating flag, usable_tools/unavailable_tools for your grant. Retrieve with get_skill; listing does not install skills. Host CLI: memrain skillpack builds a tarball + SHA-256 manifest; skillpack lint checks actual tools/commands.

name: list_concepts
description: List synthesized concept pages (LLM-derived from the corpus by the synthesize-concepts cycle phase): concept_slug, title, tier (T1/T2/T3), atom_count, narrative. Ordered by atom_count DESC. Read-only; internal-only (derived over private notes).

name: list_takes
description: List synthesized 'takes' (opinionated claims the propose-takes phase derived, optionally graded): take_key, claim_text, kind, weight, domain, status (queued/accepted/rejected). Optional filters: `kind`, `domain`; `sort` (generated_at default | weight), `offset` for pagination. Advisory only — never mutates notes. Read-only; internal-only.

kind.description: Filter to one take kind (e.g. bet, judgment).

holder.description: Filter to one holder (world | brain | people/<slug> | companies/<slug>).

name: set_take_status
description: Set a synthesized take's review status: mark it 'accepted' or 'rejected' by take_key. Advisory only — never mutates notes, only the take's own review flag. Tenant-scoped: a take_key that isn't yours is a no-op. Internal-only.

name: takes_add
description: Append a canonical takes-fence row; retain other rows/history. Requires owned page, current version and permitted holder; records authenticated actor. dry_run previews; optional plan_hash pins it. Static public forbidden.

dry_run.description: Preview the bounded row diff without writes or model calls.

plan_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 from the matching preview.

reason.description: Optional version reason, up to 500 Unicode code points.

wait_for_index.description: Wait for the search mirror after applying.

claim.description: Single-line claim, up to 4000 Unicode code points.

source.description: Single-line citation, up to 4000 Unicode code points.

holder.description: world, brain, people/<slug> or companies/<slug>; constrained by the credential.

name: takes_update
description: Patch a canonical takes row at the required page version; retain unrelated bytes/rows and holder. Changed claims clear old resolution. dry_run previews; plan_hash pins it. Static public forbidden.

dry_run.description: Preview the bounded row diff without writes or model calls.

plan_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 from the matching preview.

reason.description: Optional version reason, up to 500 Unicode code points.

wait_for_index.description: Wait for the search mirror after applying.

claim.description: Single-line claim, up to 4000 Unicode code points.

source.description: Single-line citation, up to 4000 Unicode code points.

active.description: False retracts the row using strikethrough; true reactivates it.

name: takes_resolve
description: Resolve an active take atomically in its page/ledger. Requires current version and holder permission; actor/time are server-set. dry_run previews; plan_hash pins the request, but apply's timestamp may change after_hash. Static public forbidden.

dry_run.description: Preview the bounded row diff without writes or model calls.

plan_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 from the matching preview.

reason.description: Optional version reason, up to 500 Unicode code points.

wait_for_index.description: Wait for the search mirror after applying.

evidence.description: Single-line evidence, up to 4000 Unicode code points.

value.description: Finite numeric result, preserved without display rounding.

name: takes_search
description: Fuzzy-search synthesized 'takes' by claim text (pg_trgm similarity + substring fallback), ranked best-match first: take_key, claim_text, kind, weight, domain, status. Read-only; internal-only.

name: get_calibration_profile
description: The latest narrative calibration/bias profile (from the calibration-profile phase): grade tallies, accuracy, pattern statements, bias tags. Read-only; internal-only. Null when no profile has been generated yet.

name: takes_scorecard
description: Read latest grades of synthesized takes: total/graded/resolved, verdict counts, accuracy=correct/(correct+incorrect), partial_rate, Brier score over correct/incorrect bets versus stated weight. Zero before opt-in grading. Filter domain/holder and generated since/until; source and holder grants apply. Internal-only, no LLM.

domain.description: Filter to takes tagged with this domain.

holder.description: Filter to this holder (world|brain|<slug>). Still gated by the token's takes-holder allow-list.

since.description: Only takes generated on/after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

until.description: Only takes generated on/before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: takes_calibration
description: Reliability buckets for latest correct/incorrect take grades: observed hit-rate vs mean stated weight. bucket_size in (0,1], default .1. Empty before grading. Filter domain/holder within source/holder grants. Internal-only, read-only, no LLM.

domain.description: Filter to takes tagged with this domain.

holder.description: Filter to this holder (world|brain|<slug>). Still gated by the token's takes-holder allow-list.

name: extract_facts
description: Extract events, preferences, commitments and beliefs from text OR a source_ref page in your grant. Preview by default; persist:true needs write scope and stores rows in your source. entity_hints steer extraction; session_id and visibility stamp stored facts. Input is sanitized and DATA-fenced. Paid, budget-guarded Bedrock; returns enabled:false unless MEMRAIN_FACTS_EXTRACTION=1. Internal-only.

text.description: Raw conversation/transcript text to extract from. Provide this OR `source_ref`.

source_ref.description: A page slug whose markdown_body is extracted (tenant-scoped). Provide this OR `text`.

persist.description: Write the extracted facts to the ledger (default false = preview only). Requires a write grant.

entity_hints.description: Comma/space-separated canonical entity slugs to steer the extractor.

session_id.description: Capture-session id stamped on persisted facts.

visibility.description: Default visibility for persisted facts (default private).

name: list_skills
description: Find skills in this brain's local pack by task. With query, rank by slug, description and triggers (exact slug first), returning up to 5 by default. Without arguments, return the full byte-ordered catalog. Each entry includes triggers, tools split into usable_tools/unavailable_tools for your grant, mutating, requires and writes_to. Fetch a match with get_skill. Read-only; no LLM.

query.description: Task or skill name, at most 200 characters.

limit.description: Maximum skills; default 5 with query, otherwise all.

name: get_skill
description: Fetch one brain-resident skill's full markdown body by slug (as returned by list_skills). Returns {slug, description, body, frontmatter, usable_tools, unavailable_tools}, or an error when the slug is unknown. Read-only; no LLM.

name.description: Skill slug exactly as returned by list_skills.

name: get_recent_transcripts
description: Recently-ingested conversation transcript pages (types: meeting, email, journal, note), newest-first, within a day window. Returns each page's slug/type/title/updated_at plus a summary (first ~300 chars) or — with summary=false — the body capped at 100 KB. Tenant-scoped; limit-capped (default 50, max 200). Surfaces page bodies — hidden from public ingress. Read-only; no LLM.

days.description: Only pages updated within the last N days. Default 30.

summary.description: true (default) returns a ~300-char summary; false returns the body capped at 100 KB.

name: think
description: Multi-hop cited synthesis from pages, takes, graph and trajectories, with conflicts/gaps. Paid, budget-guarded Sonnet; default-off (ran:false unless MEMRAIN_THINK=1). save writes synthesis/<slug> + evidence; take queues its anchor-pinned headline. Both are operator-only, silently ignored otherwise. rounds 1..3 feeds gaps into scoped retrieval. synthesis_status: ok/empty_answer/not_json/output_truncated/no_llm/model_unusable/llm_error. Failed composition over gathered pages keeps synthesis:null and adds a cited extractive fallback (kind:extractive, no model call, never saved).

anchor.description: Pull the entity subgraph + trajectory around this slug (required for take:true).

rounds.description: Gather/synthesize rounds; each extra round is a fresh paid call under the run budget. Default 1.

save.description: Persist the synthesis as a page + evidence rows. Operator-only; ignored otherwise.

take.description: Queue the answer's headline claim as a synth_take on `anchor`. Operator-only; ignored otherwise.

model.description: Model id override for the synthesis call.

since.description: Only gather pages whose content date is >= this ISO date.

until.description: Only gather pages whose content date is <= this ISO date.

reference_date.description: The day to treat as today when reading relative dates in the question (YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future). Default: today in the brain's time zone.

name: put_raw_data
description: Upsert a page payload keyed by (slug,source), REPLACING the prior payload, not keeping history; max 1 MB. source is a data-provider/importer label, not tenant ownership. Requires a live page (else not_found) in the caller’s write source. Write; public forbidden.

slug.description: The owning page slug; must be a live page.

source.description: Data-source label, e.g. an importer name.

data.description: The raw payload (plain JSON object, <= 1 MB serialized).

name: get_raw_data
description: Read a page's raw_data sidecar rows, newest first. Optional `source` filter to one data-source label; `limit` (1..200, default 50). Tenant-scoped via the owning page. Read-only; no LLM.

name: log_ingest
description: Append one ingestion-event row to the audit log (importer/webhook runs, absorb outcomes). Stamped with the caller's write source. WRITE.

source_type.description: Event family, e.g. 'facts:absorb' or an importer name.

pages_updated.description: Slugs touched by the run (array of strings).

name: get_ingest_log
description: Recent ingestion-log entries, newest first, scoped to the caller's read set. Optional `source_type` filter; `limit` (1..50, default 20). Read-only; no LLM.

name: retry_job
description: Re-queue a failed or cancelled job for another attempt (status -> pending, next_attempt_at = now). Returns the refreshed row, or found:false when the id is unknown or the job is not in a retryable state. Operator-only. WRITE — refused on public ingress.

name: get_job_progress
description: Read a job's live progress envelope: status + the handler-reported `progress` JSON (mig083). Cheap poll target while a long job runs. Operator-only; read-only.

name: sources_list
description: List registered sources (id, kind, path_prefix, policies, boost weight). A scoped caller sees ONLY the sources its grant covers; the operator sees all. Read-only; no LLM.

name: sources_status
description: Per-source diagnostic: the source row plus its live health (document/chunk counts, embed coverage, staleness lag, failed jobs). A scoped caller may only query a source inside its grant. Read-only; no LLM.

name: get_status_snapshot
description: One-shot operational snapshot for thin-client status: version, corpus stats, brain health (embed coverage, staleness, job queue), query-cache state, and the active job worker lock. Operator-only (exposes whole-brain operational state); read-only; no Bedrock.

name: run_doctor
description: Run the thin-client brain health checks and return a structured report: config-free engine checks only (stats, embed coverage/staleness, tenancy/federation health, OAuth client hygiene, source routing, job worker liveness). Operator-only; read-only; never mutates; no LLM.

name: chronicle_day
description: Life-chronicle timeline for one UTC calendar day (or the ISO week containing it, with `week:true`). Returns the projected events — each a summary/detail joined to its depth page and, for an event projection, the event kind. `narrative:true` also returns a day-by-day prose rendering. Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

week.description: Expand to the ISO week (Mon–Sun) containing `date`.

narrative.description: Also return a readable day-by-day prose summary.

name: chronicle_since
description: Life-chronicle events on or after a date, oldest-first. Returns the projected timeline rows. Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

name: chronicle_on_this_day
description: Life-chronicle 'on this day': events from the same month+day in prior years, most-recent-first. `date` defaults to today (UTC). Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

date.description: Target day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: chronicle_last_seen
description: When an entity last appeared in the life chronicle — the most recent timeline day its own page or an event's `who` array references it, plus days_ago. Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

entity.description: Entity slug (e.g. people/alice) or name to match.

name: ontology_get
description: The live per-dimension ontology for an entity: the current value on each axis (role, employer, location, …), confidence, provenance, and bi-temporal validity. `asof` time-travels to a past date; `min_confidence` floors the rows; `include_quarantined` surfaces novel/unconfirmed dimensions. Non-operator callers see world-visible rows only and never diary-sourced values. Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

asof.description: Resolve the ontology as of this YYYY-MM-DD (valid-time travel).

name: ontology_propose
description: Record a dimensional observation about an entity (entity has dimension=value, e.g. role=advisor). Sourced, confidence-weighted, and bi-temporal: a novel dimension lands quarantined, a same-value re-observation corroborates, a different value supersedes forward (or closes a backdated interval). WRITE — refused on public ingress.

entity.description: Entity slug the claim is about (e.g. people/alice).

source.description: Provenance page slug (source_slug); omit for a manual claim.

valid_from.description: Start of validity, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today; null = -infinity.

name: ontology_dimensions
description: Which dimension axes exist across the (scoped) corpus and how heavily each is used — [{dimension, entities, observations}], busiest first. Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

name: ontology_conflicts
description: Entities whose currently-open observations on one dimension disagree — at least two distinct values from at least two distinct sources. For non-operator callers, diary-sourced values are stripped and a conflict that no longer disagrees after that stripping is dropped. Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

name: volunteer_chronicle
description: Push-based chronicle context: the recent timeline plus the validity-resolved ontology for the named entities, composed with zero LLM. Non-operator callers get a redacted view (diary-sourced + private-visibility ontology stripped). Tenant-scoped. Read-only; no LLM.

days.description: Lookback window for the recent timeline (default 7, cap 50).

entities.description: Entity slugs to resolve current ontology for (array or comma-separated string).

name: chronicle_backfill
description: Enqueue one paid chronicle-extract job per eligible scoped conversation page, excluding diary/events. Returns pages_enqueued and per-page MEMRAIN_CHRONICLE_WRITE_BUDGET_USD for worst-case spend. dry_run:true counts only. Operator-only write; public forbidden.

dry_run.description: Count eligible pages without enqueuing (default false).

limit.description: Max pages to sweep (default 100, hard cap 500).
